notes: «- يعني ابن عباس -» is an editor's gloss and is left out; the surface «ابن عم، نبيكم» is written as the text has it, an epithet that the gloss identifies
«قال سمعت أبا العالية» : Qatada heard Abu al-Aliya, so both are links
«ونسبه إلى أبيه» and the later sayings («موسى آدم»، «عيسى جعد») have no transmitter of their own: they belong to the same report
